marriage.title: Realm Marriage · Bonds of the Realm
marriage.proposal_instructions: Hold an engagement ring and right-click the other player.
marriage.recipient: Only the recipient can accept this proposal.
marriage.confirm_hint: This decision affects the relationship. Reserved money stays assigned to its rightful owners.
marriage.engagement_first: Accept a proposal before preparing a ceremony.
marriage.split_rule: The first partner receives the rounded-down percentage; the second receives the remaining cents.
marriage.fee_quote: Current fee for a new agreement
marriage.joint_details: Joint money consolidates both wallets when marrying. New personal income may be consolidated at the altar; other mods must opt into the payment API.
marriage.payment_api_hint: Shared purchases require an explicit integration. Existing mods keep their own payment rules.
marriage.speaker: The floor is given to
marriage.reason_hint: Your objection pauses the ceremony; it does not cancel it.
marriage.hud.objections: Speak now, or forever hold your peace!
marriage.hud.party_hint: You may withdraw from the ceremony at any time.
marriage.hud.discussion: The couple decides whether to continue.
marriage.hud.official: Officially married, with the realm as witness.
marriage.notice.invitation: You have a ceremony invitation from %s.
marriage.help: Use an engagement ring on a player or prepare your ceremony at a Wedding Altar.
marriage.error.capacity: Registry capacity reached. Existing receipts were preserved.
marriage.error.party: Only the authorised partners may make this decision.
marriage.error.occupied: A player or this altar already has an active ceremony or relationship.
marriage.error.proposal: This proposal cannot be accepted here or has expired.
marriage.error.planning: The agreement may only change before the ceremony.
marriage.error.priest: The chosen celebrant must accept and be present.
marriage.error.witnesses: Check the invited witnesses and their consent.
marriage.error.agreement: Both partners must accept a valid financial agreement.
marriage.error.invitation: Both partners must choose you before you can accept.
marriage.error.ready: The couple, celebrant and invited witnesses must accept first.
marriage.error.phase: This action is not available at this ceremony stage.
marriage.error.objection: The objection window is closed or an objection is already registered.
marriage.error.reason: Only the objector may submit a reason, up to 256 characters.
marriage.error.resume: Both partners must agree before the celebrant resumes.
marriage.error.vows: Both individual vows and the invited witnesses are required.
marriage.error.pending: An earlier financial receipt is still pending. Retry after recovery.
marriage.error.married: This action requires your current official marriage.
marriage.error.amount: Enter a valid positive euro amount within the limits.
marriage.error.transaction: The financial receipt is invalid or its original payload changed.
marriage.error.funds: Insufficient funds or the account is locked for settlement.
marriage.error.consumer: Only the registered payment integration may use this receipt.
marriage.error.storage: Persistent storage is unavailable. Preserve the data and restart after fixing storage.
marriage.error.wallet: The Chronicles wallet could not be updated safely.
marriage.error.chronicles: This financial regime requires Chronicles RP.
marriage.error.profile: Create a Chronicles RP character first.
marriage.error.ambiguous: The saved receipt does not match the current player state. No payment was repeated.
marriage.error.altar: Use an intact nearby Wedding Altar.
marriage.error.presence: The couple, chosen celebrant and invited witnesses must be alive and near the altar.
marriage.error.request: Invalid or expired request. Refresh the menu.
marriage.error.stale: The registry changed. Refresh and confirm the current information.
marriage.error.governor: Only the sworn President or an authorised administrator may change the fee.
marriage.error.fee: The fee exceeds the permitted limit or the treasury is unavailable.
marriage.error.crown: This fee requires Crown Ledger 0.2.7 or a compatible marriage API. Funds remain reserved.
marriage.error.council: Realm Council is unavailable or incompatible.
marriage.error.documents: Only married partners may claim their own uncollected documents.
marriage.error.inventory: Free two inventory slots for your ring and certificate.
marriage.error.forged: This item is not an authentic marriage document.
marriage.audit.speaker: Speaker selected
